description: This is a FastAPI module defining CRUD endpoints for managing teacher user accounts, including creation, listing, retrieval, updating, and deletion, secured with JWT authentication.

classes.name: TeacherCreate
classes.description: Pydantic model for creating a new teacher, including username, full name, email, password, and role.

classes.name: TeacherUpdate
classes.description: Pydantic model for updating a teacher, with optional fields for full name, email, and password.

classes.name: TeacherOut
classes.description: Response model representing a teacher's information, including id, username, full name, email, and role.

methods.name: create_teacher(teacher: TeacherCreate, db: Session = Depends(get_db), user: User = Depends(get_current_user))
methods.description: Creates a new teacher user after validating uniqueness of username and email; hashes the password before storing.

methods.name: list_teachers(skip: int = 0, limit: int = 100, db: Session = Depends(get_db), user: User = Depends(get_current_user))
methods.description: Retrieves a list of all users with the teacher role, supporting pagination with skip and limit.

methods.name: get_teacher(teacher_id: int, db: Session = Depends(get_db), user: User = Depends(get_current_user))
methods.description: Fetches a teacher's details by ID; returns 404 if not found.

methods.name: update_teacher(teacher_id: int, update: TeacherUpdate, db: Session = Depends(get_db), user: User = Depends(get_current_user))
methods.description: Updates a teacher's profile including optional password change; raises 404 if teacher not found.

methods.name: delete_teacher(teacher_id: int, db: Session = Depends(get_db), user: User = Depends(get_current_user))
methods.description: Deletes a teacher user by ID; raises 404 if the teacher does not exist.
